subject: info-trns
title: INFO.TRNS.------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in WM-26, the page where Braxton declares that 'the progressional actualness of a given creative manifestation transcends the particulars of any one empirical criterion, and as such the whole subject of musicology has to be dealt with very delicately.' INFO-TRNS (information transference) is *crossed* — (c) prefix, the concept of — with SOC-RT (social reality), the central claim being that what gets transmitted as 'information' about world creativity is structurally entangled with the social-reality position of the transmitting culture. Besides the main line, three branches radiate from INFO-TRNS: into MT-DI (multi-dimensional/ism), which carries EXT-FT (extended functionalism) with a dashed link to OP-DY (option dynamics), and a dashed link to MTH (methodology); into TR (transformation) → A-PR (all-purpose), with a dashed link to SPT-AW (spiritual awareness) → CI; and into CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) → POL-DYM (political dynamics), with a dashed link to PAFT.
